blueprintMeta.name: Bug reproduction
blueprintMeta.description: A pinned, one-click environment for reporting a WordPress bug or reviewing a pull request.

muPlugins.content:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Reproduction environment
 */
add_shortcode( 'repro_environment', function () {
	$hello_dolly = get_file_data(
		WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/hello-dolly/hello.php',
		array( 'Version' => 'Version' )
	);
	$hello_dolly_status = in_array(
		'hello-dolly/hello.php',
		(array) get_option( 'active_plugins', array() ),
		true
	) ? 'active' : 'inactive';

	return '<dl><dt>WordPress</dt><dd>' . esc_html( get_bloginfo( 'version' ) ) . '</dd><dt>PHP</dt><dd>' . esc_html( PHP_MAJOR_VERSION . '.' . PHP_MINOR_VERSION ) . '</dd><dt>Hello Dolly</dt><dd>' . esc_html( $hello_dolly['Version'] . ' (' . $hello_dolly_status . ')' ) . '</dd></dl>';
} );

source.post_content:
Bug reproduction

[repro_environment]

Steps to reproduce

  1. Read the WordPress, PHP, and Hello Dolly versions shown above.
  2. Confirm Hello Dolly is active and compare all three values with the Expected section.

Expected

The page reports WordPress 6.8.3, PHP 8.3, and Hello Dolly 1.7.2 (active).

Actual

The environment table above shows the versions and plugin state loaded by this run.
